fields.manage_booking_url: https URL of the manage-trip page on the airline's own site, or null if not verified
fields.phone: customer-service number in E.164 form, or null if not verified
fields.verified_on: date both manage_booking_url and phone were checked by hand, or null
fields.sources: official page(s) the values were taken from
fields.note: why a field is null, when it is

HA.name: Hawaiian Airlines
HA.note: An older Hawaiian Manage Trip page lists +1-800-713-1220; treated as stale.

AA.name: American Airlines
AA.note: Reservations line 800-433-7300 appears on the aa.com page but was not confirmed by a direct page read (aa.com returned 403). Manage-trip URL not verified.

UA.name: United Airlines
UA.note: 1-800-UNITED-1 (800-864-8331) appears on a united.com page, but the phone is not confirmed on a page that is reservations-specific. Manage-trip URL not verified (united.com fetch timed out).

B6.name: JetBlue Airways
B6.note: Sources disagree: 1-800-538-2583 is cited in an old press release and a help page for SSR requests; 1-888-538-2583 is the groups desk; 1-800-336-5530 is listed as TTY on flight terms. Manage-trip page fetch showed no trip details. Neither field verified.

G4.name: Allegiant Air
G4.note: Manage-trip URL confirmed from the Manage Trip header link. The contact page read showed only a text line (+1 866-432-6165), not a voice line; (702) 505-8888 from search snippets is not confirmed. Phone unverified.

SY.name: Sun Country Airlines
SY.note: Reservations line 651-905-2737 appears on Sun Country pages per search snippets, not confirmed by direct read. Manage-trip URL not verified.

NK.name: Spirit Airlines
NK.note: Spirit's support page says an orderly wind-down began 2026-05-02, all flights cancelled, and no customer call center remains. No customer-service number is published; do not show a phone.
